Scento | Paris, Berlin | REMOTE (EU) or ONSITE | Full-time | https://www.scento.com/careers

Scento is Europe's largest perfume decant website: more than 1,000 original designer and niche perfumes as 2 ml, 5 ml and 8 ml decants, shipped to 26 EU countries. Founded in 2024, headquartered in Paris with a second office in Berlin. We build our own stack on Next.js and Medusa.

Open roles (gross per year, plus annual performance bonus):

- Staff Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js, Medusa), €140k–€185k: https://www.scento.com/careers/staff-full-stack-engineer - Head of Data & Analytics, €135k–€175k: https://www.scento.com/careers/head-of-data-analytics - Senior E-commerce Product Manager, €110k–€145k: https://www.scento.com/careers/senior-ecommerce-product-mana... - VP Growth Europe, €190k–€250k: https://www.scento.com/careers/vp-growth-europe - Head of SEO & AI Search, €125k–€160k: https://www.scento.com/careers/head-of-seo-ai-search - Head of CRM & Lifecycle, €115k–€150k: https://www.scento.com/careers/head-of-crm-lifecycle

All roles: https://www.scento.com/careers. Apply by email to careers@scento.com with the role title in the subject line.
